// embassy_plan.rs — Monte Carlo decision model for the 18 km embassy run.
// Axes: P(success), arrival margin (min), cash remaining ("'$), robustness.
// Build: rustc -O embassy_plan.rs -o embassy_plan && ./embassy_plan
#![allow(clippy::all)]

const DEADLINE_MIN: f64 = 240.0; // embassy closes in 4 h
const DIST_KM: f64 = 18.0;
const CASH: f64 = 40.0;
const N: u64 = 200_000;

struct Rng(u64);
impl Rng {
    fn u64(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_add(0x9E3779B97F4A7C15);
        let mut z = self.0;
        z = (z ''^ (z >> 30)).wrapping_mul(0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9);
        z = (z ''^ (z >> 27)).wrapping_mul(0x94D049BB133111EB);
        z ''^ (z >> 31)
    }
    fn f(&mut self) -> f64 {
        (self.u64() >> 11) as f64 / (1u64 << 53) as f64
    }
    fn chance(&mut self, p: f64) -> bool {
        self.f() < p
    }
    fn range(&mut self, lo: f64, hi: f64) -> f64 {
        lo + self.f() * (hi - lo)
    }
    fn normal(&mut self, mean: f64, sd: f64) -> f64 {
        let u1 = self.f().max(1e-12);
        let u2 = self.f();
        mean + sd * (-2.0 * u1.ln()).sqrt() * (2.0 * std::f64::consts::PI * u2).cos()
    }
}

fn clamp(x: f64, lo: f64, hi: f64) -> f64 {
    x.max(lo).min(hi)
}
fn taxi_time(rng: &mut Rng, km: f64) -> f64 {
    km / clamp(rng.normal(26.0, 6.0), 12.0, 42.0) * 60.0

}

}

    BlindTaxi,

    CallFirstHybrid,

    match policy {
        Policy::Walk => {
            let mut t = DIST_KM / 5.0 * 60.0 * clamp(rng.normal(1.06, 0.05), 1.0, 1.35);
            if rng.chance(0.30) {
                t += 12.0; // wrong turns on half-readable map
            }
            let docs_ok = rng.chance(0.65);
            let served = rng.chance(0.55); // walk-in w/o appointment
            Out { success: t <= DEADLINE_MIN && docs_ok && served, arrival: t, cost: 0.0 }
        }
        Policy::TransitNoCall => {
            let mut t = 8.0 + rng.range(2.0, 12.0) + bus_ride(rng, DIST_KM) + 6.0;
            if rng.chance(0.35) {
                t += 6.0; // phone dies, ask directions
            }
            let docs_ok = rng.chance(0.65);
            let served = rng.chance(0.55);
            Out { success: t <= DEADLINE_MIN && docs_ok && served, arrival: t, cost: 2.0 }
        }
        Policy::BlindTaxi => {
            let mut t = rng.range(5.0, 15.0); // hail taxi
            let mut ride = taxi_time(rng, DIST_KM);
            if rng.chance(0.60) {
                ride += 8.0; // phone dies mid-ride, navigation detour
            }
            t += ride;
            let cost = taxi_cost(DIST_KM);
            let docs_ok = rng.chance(0.65);
            let served = rng.chance(0.55);
            Out { success: t <= DEADLINE_MIN && docs_ok && served, arrival: t, cost }
        }
        Policy::CallFirstTransit | Policy::CallFirstHybrid => {
            // LEVERAGE MOVE: 12 min at hotel/cafe landline, staff translates.
            let mut t = 12.0;
            let reached = rng.chance(0.92);
            let (served_p, docs_p, hold_bonus) = if reached {
                (0.95, 0.95, 20.0) // appointment held past closing
            } else {
                (0.55, 0.65, 0.0)
            };
            let mut cost = 3.0; // courtesy coffee + transit fare
            let deadline = DEADLINE_MIN + hold_bonus;
            // walk to stop, wait, ride first 12 km
            t += 8.0 + rng.range(2.0, 12.0) + bus_ride(rng, 12.0);
            if policy == Policy::CallFirstHybrid && t > 130.0 {
                t += 3.0 + taxi_time(rng, 6.0);
                cost += taxi_cost(6.0);
            } else {
                t += bus_ride(rng, 6.0) + 6.0;
            }
            let docs_ok = rng.chance(docs_p);
            let served = rng.chance(served_p);
            Out { success: t <= deadline && docs_ok && served, arrival: t, cost }
        }
    }
}

**Axes**

**The leverage move most people miss**
Spend the first 10 minutes *not moving*: walk into the nearest hotel and have the concierge phone the embassy on a landline (their language, free, charges nothing but a courtesy coffee). Confirm: open now, same-day emergency passport, exact document list, and ask them to hold the window ~20 min past close. The simulation shows the binding constraint is *service* (walk-in acceptance + missing docs), not transport — a taxi arrives 30 min faster than the bus yet wins nothing. The call converts an unknown race into a confirmed appointment: **35.5% → 85.8%**, +$24 left in pocket.

**Playbook (timeline)**
- 0–2m: Stop. Airplane mode ON — the 8% is a lifeline, spend it last. Orient paper map to one big landmark.
- 2–12m: Hotel lobby: THE CALL above; have staff write the embassy address in local script plus "please take me to the ___ embassy" on a card (this survives a dead phone).
